# Case Ledger User Guide Extract

**Publication date:** March 2019  
**Document status:** The cover page labels this guide as approved.

## Creating a Case

An advisor selects a requester, chooses one of twelve case categories, enters
a description, and saves the case. Every new case enters the Central Intake
queue.

## Assignment

Only supervisors can assign a case. Advisors may work on a case after a
supervisor assigns it to them.

## Closure

A closed case cannot be edited or reopened. New information must be recorded
in a new linked case.

## Attachments

Each case may contain up to five attachments. Individual attachments must not
exceed ten megabytes.

## Reports

The application generates a weekly summary every Monday morning. No other
scheduled export is described.

No revision after 2019 was supplied with the source material.
